national.line: A high school teacher in Sandy Springs, Georgia, found a tiny black cat stuck in her car engine on the way to work, just in time for her Halloween wedding anniversary.
A couple who dreamed of buying a certain house as teenagers slipped a handwritten note under its door twenty years later, and that note helped make the house theirs.
A woman accidentally said "Love you!" to an important client at the end of a call, and he answered so kindly he even followed up with a heartwarming email.
Actor Brendan Fraser surprised a theater full of fans by showing up in costume at a screening of his movie The Mummy, and now everyone wants a fourth one.
A retired Oregon couple facing hard times got a brand-new heating and cooling system worth sixteen thousand dollars for free, through a program that has helped about 3,100 people.
A kitten rescued from a car wash in Marlboro, New Jersey, has now found its forever home.
An expedition searching for Amelia Earhart's lost plane has wrapped up, and the crew says it found no conclusive evidence of the wreckage, so the mystery goes on.
University of California Santa Cruz researchers found that simply steaming the soil works as well as chemicals for growing bigger, more reliable crops of organic strawberries.
Michigan benched its starting quarterback at halftime, and true freshman backup Tommy Carr came in and rallied the team to a 21 to 18 win over Penn State on Saturday.
In Tualatin, Oregon, people climbed into giant hollowed-out pumpkins and paddled them across the water in the town's annual pumpkin regatta.

local.line: The City of Lebanon has gone back to the drawing board on a new city logo, and the latest proposal comes with a fresh slogan: "Build your journey here."
A Lebanon woman living with a rare condition called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome got a big boost when a neighboring church stepped in and built her a ramp.
The Lebanon Jackets marching band brought home a placing at the Valhalla Marching Festival.
The Joel E. Barber school district is looking at building a high school add-on to its existing building, and the superintendent recently walked through what that could look like.
A Kansas man snagging for the very first time reeled in a world-record 164-pound paddlefish at Lake of the Ozarks last weekend.
Camdenton beat Capital City in a back-and-forth Week 8 football game, sealed by a go-ahead touchdown run from Michael Maschino.
A developer wants to build a new 126-room Hyatt hotel in Backwater Jack's cove at Lake of the Ozarks.
Nearly 2,300 boaters turned out for the Fall Harbor Hop on a sunny day to celebrate the end of another season at Lake of the Ozarks.
October felt like July at Lake of the Ozarks on Tuesday, October 13, when temperatures hit the low 90s and set a new heat record.
Angi Uber started at Ozarks Kat and K9 Shelter in Sunrise Beach twenty years ago scooping poop, and today she runs the place as operations director.
Patrick Mahomes' mom has set the record straight: the Chiefs quarterback does not have a home at Lake of the Ozarks.
Rockin' Rogersville started as one night of live music and, in its ninth year, has grown into a full community festival with food and local vendors.
The Orionid meteor shower peaks this Wednesday night across the Ozarks, with 10 to 20 shooting stars an hour under mostly clear skies, even with a nearly full moon.
The Community Foundation of the Ozarks has $120,000 available through its Everyone Outdoors grant program and is now taking applications for projects across the region.
The Go Baby Go program is building custom mobility toy cars so kids across the Ozarks can get around and play.
A restaurant in Ozark, Missouri, is famous for one thing: the staff tosses hot rolls at you across the room.

music.line: Tim McGraw, Paul Overstreet and The Stanley Brothers are officially in the Country Music Hall of Fame.
Morgan Wallen is curating his own 24-hour SiriusXM channel called Morgan Wallen Radio.
Ella Langley is celebrating one whole year of her smash hit "Choosin' Texas," saying she's constantly and consistently amazed by the response.
Zach Top has added new arena dates to his Cold Beer and Country Music Tour.
Trace Adkins is celebrating thirty years of his album Dreamin' Out Loud with its first-ever vinyl release.
Zach Bryan opened up about getting sober in a two-hour interview with Matthew McConaughey that went up on YouTube on October 16.
Brothers Osborne are previewing their upcoming album Watertown with a new track called "Doors."
Riley Green's top ten songs range from heartbreaking ballads to rowdy honky-tonk tunes, and fans are ranking their favorites.
